name: Seba
overview: Seba is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Cush, according to Genesis 10:7. Beyond this genealogical detail, no additional tribal affiliation or personal notes are recorded. His mention situates him within the early post-flood genealogies that trace the descendants of Noah.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Seba' appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:7 without any given meaning or divine attribution. Therefore, the biblical text provides no further insight into the significance of his name beyond its identification.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Seba as a son of Cush, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented in the biblical text for Seba beyond this filial link.
scriptureSignificance: Seba's significance lies primarily in his place within the Table of Nations, where he is listed among the descendants of Cush. This genealogy serves to map the origins of various peoples after the flood and highlights the fulfillment of God's command to populate the earth. Seba's mention underscores the biblical emphasis on lineage and the unfolding of God's providential plan through families.
